solution.text: Tangents drawn from external points are of equal length. $\Rightarrow \quad B D=B E=a-r$ $[\because C D=r]$ and $\quad A F=A E=b-r$ $[\because C F=r]$ $A E+B E=A B$ $\Rightarrow \quad b-r+a-r=2 R$ $1 \because A B$ is a diameter of circumcircle] $\Leftrightarrow \quad b+a=2 R+2 r$ $\Rightarrow \quad 2(r+R)=a+b$
